speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There he is. Shut, as you said. The chronicle can be a bed for an hour. I am not owed a page of it before dinner.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I looked at the bundle because I look at anything red in a room with a cat. It is tied. He is not on it. That is the whole of my inspection, and I am not doing a second.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not do a second. If I write tonight I write on a loose leaf. The fair copy stays a fair copy. A morning of other men's cues is not a reason to untie Verona.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I do not know Verona from a knot, and I do not want the lesson. Dinner is a table. The broth is on the side. She will cut when she cuts, and not because you have come in interesting.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not interesting. I am a man who wants a chair and a shut mouth. The apples are still on the sill. The day has not improved them, and neither have I.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Sit, then. I will not bring the broth up. If you fall asleep on your own papers I will wake you when the loaf is touched, and not before.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Wake me if I sleep. I do not mean to sleep. I mean to look at a leaf that is not the bundle and not the cat's book. There is a difference, and I would like an hour of it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: An hour is what you have, near enough, if she is in the temper she was in when you left. Do not make the hour into a mess she can see from the door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No mess. One leaf. And if he snores, the chronicle has my permission, which it did not ask.
